# A Multimodal Dataset for Autonomous Probe Placement and Needle Retrieval in Ultrasound-Guided Liver Biopsy (US-PPNR) - README --- ## 📋 At a Glance Multimodal, time-synchronized demonstrations of ultrasound-guided needle biopsy on clinically realistic phantoms/tissue, including ultrasound imaging, multi-view video, robot kinematics, force/torque, and optical tracking. --- ## 📖 Dataset Overview This dataset supports training and evaluating vision-language-action (VLA) and imitation-learning policies for **ultrasound (US)-guided needle biopsy**. It covers the procedures including: scanning and probe placement, needle tracking, and probe adjustments to maintain needle visualization. Each trajectory provides synchronized **US B-mode**, **RGB room video**, **RGB-D wrist video**, **robot joint/task-space states**, **force/torque**, and **NDI optical tracking** for needle/probe/camera poses, plus time-aligned narration/metadata. | | | |:-----------------------|:-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | **Total Trajectories** | 2,546 | | **Total Hours** | 10:51:09 | | **Data Type** | \[✅] Clinical \[✅] Ex-Vivo \[✅] Table-Top Phantom \[ ] Digital Simulation \[✅] Physical Simulation | | **License** | CC BY 4.0 | | **Version** | 1.0 | --- ## 🎯 Tasks & Domain ### Domain - [ ] **Surgical Robotics** - [x] **Ultrasound Robotics** - [ ] **Other Healthcare Robotics** ### Demonstrated Skills - Probe Placement (**PP.tar.gz**): - Autonomous probe placement for liver scanning - Needle Retrieval (**NR.tar.gz**): - Robust needle tracking during insertion - Autonomous needle retrieval from phantom/tissue under US guidance - Autonomous probe scanning (sweeps, plane finding) - Adaptive probe manipulation to maintain visualization --- ## 🔬 Data Collection Details ### Collection Method - [x] **Human Teleoperation** - [x] **Programmatic/State-Machine** - [ ] **AI Policy / Autonomous** - [ ] **Other** ### Operator Details | | Description | |:-------------------------|:-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | **Operator Count** | 6 | | **Operator Skill Level** | \[x] Expert (e.g., Sonographer/Clinician)
\[x] Intermediate (e.g., Trained Researcher)
\[x] Novice (e.g., ML Researcher with minimal experience)
\[ ] N/A | | **Collection Period** | From 2025-12-20 to 2026-01-18 | ### Recovery Demonstrations - [ ] **Yes** - [x] **No** --- ## 💡 Diversity Dimensions - [x] **Camera Position / Angle** - [x] **Lighting Conditions** - [x] **Target Object** (e.g., different phantom models, tissue types, lesion locations) - [x] **Spatial Layout** (e.g., varying lesion position and insertion approach) - [ ] **Robot Embodiment** (if multiple robots were used) - [x] **Task Execution** (e.g., different scanning/insertion techniques) - [x] **Background / Scene** - [ ] **Other** **Elaboration:** Data were collected across both commercial and custom-built phantoms to vary tissue appearance, acoustic properties, and lesion presentation. Trials span a range of target locations, scanning planes, insertion angles, and operator strategies (expert vs sub-expert), yielding diversity in both perception (US appearance, needle visibility) and control (probe/needle trajectories, contact forces). --- ## 🛠️ Equipment & Setup ### Robotic Platform(s) - UR5e robotic arm for **probe manipulation** (end-effector-mounted force/torque sensing; tracked probe marker) ### Sensors & Cameras | Type | Model/Details | |:---------------------------|:----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | **Medical Imager** | Ultrasound B-mode stream — **Wisonic Clover 60** + **Wisonic C5-1 convex transducer**, 1920×1080 @ 30 FPS | | **Room/3rd Person Camera** | **NDI Polaris Vega VT RGB camera**, 1024×768 @ 30 FPS | | **RGB-D Wrist Camera** | **ZED 2**, RGB + Depth, 640×480 @ 30 FPS (mounted on probe end-effector) | | **Force/Torque Sensor** | **ATI Axia80-M8**, 30 HZ, End-effector F/T sensor | | **Optical Tracker** | **NDI Polaris Vega VT**, 30 Hz, tracked poses for needle/probe/cameras/components | --- ## 🎯 Action & State Space Representation This dataset follows the **LeRobot** format and provides synchronized actions, robot state, imaging, and tracking. ### Action Space Representation **Primary Action Representation:** - [x] **Absolute Cartesian** (position/orientation relative to robot base) - [x] **Relative Cartesian** (delta position/orientation from current pose) *(typical for teleop step commands)* - [x] **Joint Space** (direct joint commands recorded from robot interface) - [ ] **Other** **Orientation Representation:** - [x] **Quaternions** (x, y, z, w) - [ ] **Euler Angles** (roll, pitch, yaw) - [ ] **Axis-Angle** (rotation vector) - [ ] **Rotation Matrix** (3x3 matrix) - [ ] **Other** **Reference Frame:** - [x] **Robot Base Frame** - [x] **Tool/End-Effector Frame** - [x] **World/Global Frame** *(via optical tracker frame)* - [ ] **Camera Frame** - [x] **Other** (calibrated US image frame) **Action Dimensions:** Actions are provided per-controlled subsystem (probe manipulation and needle insertion). **Example:** ```text action.probe_delta: "probe_delta_x", "probe_delta_y", "probe_delta_z", "probe_delta_ux", "probe_delta_uy", "probe_delta_uz", "probe_delta_w", - "probe_delta_x", "probe_delta_y", "probe_delta_z": position in UR5e robot base frame (meters) - "probe_delta_ux", "probe_delta_uy", "probe_delta_uz", "probe_delta_w": orientation as quaternion action.needle_delta: "needle_delta_x", "needle_delta_y", "needle_delta_z", "needle_delta_ux", "needle_delta_uy", "needle_delta_uz", "needle_delta_w" - "needle_delta_x", "needle_delta_y", "needle_delta_z": position in NDI optical tracker frame (meters) - "needle_delta_ux", "needle_delta_uy", "needle_delta_uz", "needle_delta_w": orientation as quaternion ``` ### State Space Representation **State Information Included:** - [x] **Joint Positions** (all articulated joints) - [ ] **Joint Velocities** - [x] **End-Effector Pose** (Cartesian position/orientation) - [x] **Force/Torque Readings** - [ ] **Gripper State** - [x] **Other** (optical tracker poses for needle/probe; calibrated transforms) **State Dimensions:** ```text observation.state.joint_positions: "elbow_joint", "shoulder_lift_joint", "shoulder_pan_joint", "wrist_1_joint", "wrist_2_joint", "wrist_3_joint", observation.state.ee_pose: "probe_ur_x", "probe_ur_y", "probe_ur_z", "probe_ur_ux", "probe_ur_uy", "probe_ur_uz", "probe_ur_w", observation.state.ee_pose_ndi: "probe_ndi_x", "probe_ndi_y", "probe_ndi_z", "probe_ndi_ux", "probe_ndi_uy", "probe_ndi_uz", "probe_ndi_w", observation.state.needle_pose_ndi: "needle_ndi_x", "needle_ndi_y", "needle_ndi_z", "needle_ndi_ux", "needle_ndi_uy", "needle_ndi_uz", "needle_ndi_w", observation.meta.force_torque: "fx", "fy", "fz", "tx", "ty", "tz" ``` --- ## ⏱️ Data Synchronization Approach All modalities are synchronized to a common time base and exported with corrected timestamps. - **Streams & rates:** robot kinematics and force/torque at **500 Hz**; NDI optical tracking at **60 Hz**; RGB/RGB-D/US at **30 FPS**. - **Delay measurement:** the robot executes controlled sinusoidal motions while each sensor stream observes the motion (needle/probe/camera movement). Phase differences between each sensor’s measured sinusoid and the robot reference are used to estimate per-stream delays. The delay was calculated using [PLUS Toolkit](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4437531/). - **Alignment:** timestamps are corrected using measured delays, and asynchronous streams are aligned via interpolation/resampling to produce unified, time-aligned trajectories. - **Recording:** all raw streams and teleop inputs are recorded in ROS (rosbag). --- ## 👥 Attribution & Contact | | | |:---------------------------|:----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | **Dataset Lead** | Shing Shin Cheng; Wei Wang; Qingpeng Ding; Yuelin Zhang; Zhouyang Hong; Luoyao Kang; Wenxuan Xie | | **Institution** | The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK); First Affiliated Hospital, Sun Yat-Sen University | | **Contact Email** | sscheng@cuhk.edu.hk | | **Citation (BibTeX)** |

def resetStatesOnDisconnect(self, parameterNode) -> None:
        """Reset calibration states when ROS disconnects."""
        parameterNode.fr3Ready = False
        parameterNode.vinsReady = False
        parameterNode.markerReady = False

    def updateROSStates(self) -> None:
        """Update calibration readiness states from ROS text messages."""
        parameterNode = self.getParameterNode()

        if not self.connectorNode:
            return

        try:
            numIncoming = self.connectorNode.GetNumberOfIncomingMRMLNodes()

            for i in range(numIncoming):
                node = self.connectorNode.GetIncomingMRMLNode(i)
                if node and node.IsA("vtkMRMLTextNode"):
                    nodeName = node.GetName()
                    state = self.parseBoolState(node.GetText())

                    if nodeName == "fr3_ready":
                        if state is not None:
                            parameterNode.fr3Ready = state
                        else:
                            logging.warning(f"Unknown FR3 state value: {node.GetText()}")

                    elif nodeName == "vins_ready":
                        if state is not None:
                            parameterNode.vinsReady = state
                        else:
                            logging.warning(f"Unknown VINS state value: {node.GetText()}")

                    elif nodeName == "marker_ready":
                        if state is not None:
                            parameterNode.markerReady = state
                        else:
                            logging.warning(f"Unknown marker state value: {node.GetText()}")

                    elif nodeName == "calib_complete":
                        if state is True:
                            previousState = parameterNode.calibrationComplete
                            parameterNode.calibrationComplete = True

                            if not previousState:
                                logging.info("Calibration completed! Making camera visible.")
                                if self.cameraModel:
                                    self.cameraModel.GetDisplayNode().SetVisibility(True)
                                else:
                                    logging.warning("Camera model not found, cannot make visible")
                                if self.cameraTripodModel:
                                    self.cameraTripodModel.GetDisplayNode().SetVisibility(True)
                                else:
                                    logging.warning("Camera tripod model not found, cannot make visible")
                                if not self.cameraTransform:
                                    logging.warning("Camera transform node not found")

                        elif state is False:
                            parameterNode.calibrationComplete = False
                        else:
                            logging.warning(f"Unknown calibration state value: {node.GetText()}")

        except Exception as e:
            logging.error(f"Error updating ROS states: {str(e)}")
            logging.error(traceback.format_exc())

    def updateROSVisualization(self) -> None:
        """Update robot joint transforms from ROS."""
        self.updateRobotJointTransforms()

    def startCalibration(self) -> None:
        """Send calibration start command to ROS via IGTL-IF."""
        if self.sendIGTLCommand("start_calibration"):
            logging.info("Successfully sent calibration start command to ROS via IGTL-IF")
        else:
            logging.warning("Failed to send calibration start command")

# CalibrationTest

class CalibrationTest(ScriptedLoadableModuleTest):
    """
    This is the test case for the Calibration module.
    Uses ScriptedLoadableModuleTest base class, available at:
    https://github.com/Slicer/Slicer/blob/main/Base/Python/slicer/ScriptedLoadableModule.py

    Tests cover:
    - Parameter node creation and state management
    - 3D scene setup (model and transform loading)
    - URDF parsing and robot hierarchy creation
    - IGTL-IF connector setup
    """

    def setUp(self):
        """Reset the state before each test."""
        slicer.mrmlScene.Clear()

    def runTest(self):
        """Run all tests."""
        self.setUp()
        self.test_ParameterNode()
        self.test_3DSceneSetup()
        self.test_URDFLoading()
        self.test_IGTLConnectorSetup()
        self.setUp()

    def test_ParameterNode(self):
        """Test that parameter node is created with correct default values."""
        self.delayDisplay("Testing parameter node creation")

        logic = CalibrationLogic()
        parameterNode = logic.getParameterNode()

        # Check that parameter node exists
        self.assertIsNotNone(parameterNode, "Parameter node should be created")

        # Check default states
        self.assertFalse(parameterNode.rosConnected, "ROS should not be connected initially")
        self.assertFalse(parameterNode.fr3Ready, "FR3 should not be ready initially")
        self.assertFalse(parameterNode.vinsReady, "VINS should not be ready initially")
        self.assertFalse(parameterNode.markerReady, "Marker detection should not be ready initially")
        self.assertFalse(parameterNode.calibrationStart, "Calibration should not be started initially")
        self.assertFalse(parameterNode.calibrationComplete, "Calibration should not be complete initially")

        # Test state changes
        parameterNode.rosConnected = True
        self.assertTrue(parameterNode.rosConnected, "Parameter node should store state changes")

        self.delayDisplay("Parameter node test passed")

    def test_3DSceneSetup(self):
        """Test that 3D scene is properly initialized with models and transforms."""
        self.delayDisplay("Testing 3D scene setup")

        logic = CalibrationLogic()

        # Setup 3D scene
        logic.setup3DScene()

        # Check that robot models were loaded (if URDF and models exist)
        if os.path.exists(logic.urdfsPath) and os.path.exists(logic.modelsPath):
            # At minimum, we should have some robot models or transforms
            hasRobotContent = (len(logic.robotModels) > 0 or
                             len(logic.robotJointTransforms) > 0 or
                             len(logic.robotLinkTransforms) > 0)

            if hasRobotContent:
                logging.info(f"Loaded {len(logic.robotModels)} robot models, "
                           f"{len(logic.robotJointTransforms)} joint transforms, "
                           f"{len(logic.robotLinkTransforms)} link transforms")
            else:
                logging.warning("No robot content loaded - check URDF and model files")
        else:
            logging.warning("URDF or models path not found - skipping robot content check")

        # Check that camera model node was created
        self.assertIsNotNone(logic.cameraModel, "Camera model reference should exist")

        # Check that camera tripod model node was created
        self.assertIsNotNone(logic.cameraTripodModel, "Camera tripod model reference should exist")

        # Check that camera transform node was created with the correct name
        self.assertIsNotNone(logic.cameraTransform, "Camera transform node should be created")
        if logic.cameraTransform:
            self.assertEqual(logic.cameraTransform.GetName(), "camera_joint",
                            "Camera transform should be named 'camera_joint'")

        self.delayDisplay("3D scene setup test passed")
